sourceNotVerified: Not found in the document: check this value carefully.
reviewPending_one: Review the AI-suggested value before saving.
reviewPending_other: Review the {{count}} AI-suggested values before saving.

fill.title: Fill the form from a document
fill.description: Upload a PDF, Word or PowerPoint document in Arabic or English. The AI proposes values for the form; nothing is saved until you review them and save.
fill.dropHint: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, or a scan (PNG, JPEG, TIFF), up to 10 MB
fill.filled_one: One field was filled from {{file}}. Review it before saving.
fill.filled_other: {{count}} fields were filled from {{file}}. Review them before saving.
fill.none: The AI found no value for this form in the document.
fill.truncated: The document is long: only its beginning was read.
fill.scanned_one: One scanned page was read by text recognition.
fill.scanned_other: {{count}} scanned pages were read by text recognition.

translate.empty: Write the text in the other language first.

similar.title: Similar items
similar.description: Check that you are not creating a duplicate.

brief.title: Approver brief
brief.changes: What changed since the last submission
brief.noChanges: First submission: nothing to compare yet.
brief.disclaimer: Written by AI from the record and its history. It does not decide: check the record before you act.

ask.title: Ask the system
ask.description: Ask about the data you are allowed to see. The AI can only read: it never changes, submits or approves anything.
ask.placeholder: e.g. Which of my items are waiting for approval?

errors.featureDisabled: This AI feature is switched off.
errors.notConfigured: No AI provider is configured for this feature.
errors.dataNotAllowed: Data of this system may not be sent to the AI.
errors.documentsNotAllowed: Sending documents to the AI is switched off.
errors.providerError: The AI provider did not answer. Try again later.
errors.timeout: The AI provider took too long to answer.
errors.invalidOutput: The AI answer could not be used. Try again.
errors.limitReached: The monthly AI limit has been reached.
errors.extractSize: The document must be at most {{maxMb}} MB.
errors.extractUnsupported: Only PDF, Word, PowerPoint and text documents can be read.
errors.extractNoText: No text was found in the document. If it is a scan, switch on text recognition (OCR) in Settings → AI.
errors.extractUnreadable: The document could not be read.
errors.briefNoApproval: The record has not been submitted for approval yet.
errors.modelsUnavailable: The model list could not be fetched: type the model name.
errors.extractOcrOff: This is a scanned image. Text recognition (OCR) is switched off in Settings → AI.

validation.endpoint: Use an http or https address.

settings.title: Artificial intelligence
settings.description: AI providers, the features people may use, what data may be sent, limits and usage. AI only drafts: people decide.
settings.masterHint: When off, no AI action appears anywhere and nothing is sent to a provider. Everything else keeps working.

providers.emptyHint: Add Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or a self-hosted model to start.
providers.keyKept: Leave empty to keep the stored key. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.

fields.name: Name
fields.modelsHint: One per line; fetched from the provider or typed.

features.accessHint: Permission {{permission}}: held by the role “AI user” (everyone) unless you change it in Roles.

data.maskHint: E-mail addresses, phone numbers, Emirates ID numbers and people's names are replaced before sending and restored in the answer.
data.documentsHint: Needed to fill forms from documents.
data.excludedHint: Field names separated by commas, e.g. Amount

ocr.title: Text recognition for scans (OCR)
ocr.enabled: Read scanned PDF pages and images
ocr.enabledHint: Pages without a text layer and PNG, JPEG or TIFF images are read by Tesseract on this server before the text goes to the AI. Values read from a scan are marked “From scan”.
ocr.available: Tesseract and the selected languages are installed on the server.
ocr.unavailable: Tesseract or one of the languages is not installed on the server: scans cannot be read until it is (see the installation guide).
ocr.languagesHint: Tesseract language codes joined by +, e.g. ara+eng

fromScanHint: Read from a scanned page by text recognition: check spelling and numbers.
